subject: Mathematics
main_theme: Counting and understanding quantities up to 20
core_concepts: Reading and writing numbers up to 20
activities: Count objects in groups up to 20
Match a number with the corresponding quantity
Count objects using fingers and other familiar materials
Complete missing numbers in a sequence
Find one more and one less than a given number
Compare two groups and identify which has more or less
learning_outcomes: Recognise and write numbers up to 20
Compare quantities using more and less
Understand one more and one less
Identify missing numbers in simple sequences
Arrange numbers in the correct order
